title: Reproducible differentiation and characterization of neurons from mouse embryonic stem cells
author: Saxena, Choudhury, et al.

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from each cell sample using the RNeasy kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol, then quantify the RNA with a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Convert 2.5 µg of each RNA preparation to cDNA using the SuperScript IV cDNA synthesis kit, following the kit instructions.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction, combine approximately 50 ng of cDNA with a gene‑specific primer mix (each primer at 0.2 µM; see primer sequences below), 2× SYBR Green master mix, and PCR‑grade water to a final volume of 10 µL in a 0.2 mL PCR tube.

substeps.instruction:
Prepare primer mix (0.2 µM each primer) using the following sequences:
- Brachyury F: GCCAAAGAAAGAAACGACCA, R: ATTGTCCGCATAGGTTGGAG (Tm 60 °C, 264 bp)
- Gapdh F: GAAGGGCTCATGACCACAGTC, R: CCTCATACTTGGCAGGTTTCTCCAGGC (Tm 60 °C, 256 bp)
- Gata6 F: GTGCAATGCATGCGGTCTCT, R: ACAGTTCATAGCAAGTGGTCGAGGCACC (Tm 60 °C, 222 bp)
- Gfap F: CACGAACGAGTCCCTAGAGC, R: ATGGTGATGCGGTTTTCTTC (Tm 60 °C, 234 bp)
- Itgam F: CTCATGGTCACCTCCTGCTT, R: CAAGCTTGTATAGGCCAGCA (Tm 60 °C, 406 bp)
- Map2 F: AGCCGCAACGCCAATGGAT, R: TTTGTTCTGAGGCTGGCGAT (Tm 60 °C, 313 bp)
- Mbp F: CTTCAAAGACAGGCCCTCAG, R: GCTGTCTCTTCCTCCCTTCC (Tm 60 °C, 213 bp)
- Nanog F: CTGAGCTATAAGCAGGTTAAG, R: ACCTGCTGAGCCCTTCTGAATC (Tm 60 °C, 114 bp)
- Oct4 F: CTCCCGAGGAGTCCCAGGAC, R: ATGAGAACCTTCAGGAGATATGCAAATCGG (Tm 60 °C, 179 bp)
- Pax6 F: AACGCGAGGAAGATGTGTCT, R: GGTACGTCTGTGTGCCTGAC (Tm 60 °C, 303 bp)
- β‑III Tubulin F: TCAGCGATGAGCACGGCATA, R: CACTCTTTCCGCACGACATC (Tm 60 °C, 301 bp)

steps.title: Run quantitative PCR
steps.instruction: Place the 10 µL reaction tubes in a real‑time PCR instrument and run the following program: 1 × 95 °C for 2 min; 40 × [95 °C for 30 s, 60 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 30 s]; 1 × 72 °C for 1 min.

steps.title: Analyze qPCR data
steps.instruction: Use Gapdh as the endogenous reference gene; calculate relative expression levels with the 2⁻ΔΔCt method.

steps.title: Set replicates and statistics
steps.instruction: Perform each experiment with at least three biological replicates and two technical replicates; compare transcript levels from EBs and neurons to ESCs using a two‑tailed Student’s t‑test and consider p < 0.05 statistically significant.
